_real_world.class: Type 382 3D air-search radar (Top Plate derivative), rotating passive array
hulls: Type 054A (all hulls, e.g. 554 Tongliao, 571 Yuncheng, 553 Dali, 552 Chenzhou)

_provenance.modeling_note: Primary 3D air-search radar for Type 054A, a Top Plate (Russian MR-710 Fregat) derivative per C-only sourcing (GlobalSecurity). No A/B detection-range figure exists; modeled as a rotating passive-array 3D air-search radar with a shorter range than the packet's fixed-face AESA modules (346A/346B/054B dual-face), consistent with its older, non-AESA, rotating-array technology generation.

sensor.type.note: Type 382 is a 3D air-search radar; Radar is the matching engine sensor type. Only C-tier sourcing exists for the designation itself

sensor.max_range.note: no A/B/C figure for Type 382 specifically; engineering estimate for a Top-Plate-class rotating 3D air-search radar, well below the packet's fixed-face AESA modules given the older rotating-array technology

sensor.fov_deg.note: 360 deg: standard convention for a rotating search radar

sensor.scan_period.note: no public rotation-rate figure; engineering estimate typical of a rotating 3D air-search radar (slower than a fixed AESA's electronic scan)

sensor.detection_prob.note: no public Pd figure; engineering estimate below the packet's AESA modules, consistent with an older passive-array radar generation

sensor.bearing_noise_std.note: no public bearing-accuracy figure; engineering estimate for a rotating passive-array 3D radar, worse than the packet's fixed AESA modules

sensor.range_noise_std.note: no public range-accuracy figure; engineering estimate for a rotating passive-array 3D radar, worse than the packet's fixed AESA modules

sensor.track_memory_s.note: no public track-coast figure; engineering estimate consistent with a general-purpose frigate air-search radar

sensor.range_power.note: radar-equation exponent (inverse-4th-power family); standard engine default, not sourced per-platform

sensor.aspect_influence.note: 0.0 disables RCS aspect-angle modeling, consistent with this packet's simplified surface-search detection model

sensor.doppler_notch_width.note: no public MTI/doppler-notch figure; engineering estimate for an older rotating-array radar

sensor.reference_snr_db.note: radar-equation calibration constant paired with reference_range_m/reference_rcs_m2 to reproduce max_range at a reference target; no public figure

sensor.reference_range_m.note: paired radar-equation calibration constant, see reference_snr_db

sensor.reference_rcs_m2.note: 5 m^2 generic warship/large-aircraft reference RCS, engine convention used across this packet's naval radar records

sensor.antenna_height_m.note: no public mast height for Type 054A; engineering estimate typical of a ~134m frigate's mast, lower than the destroyer/cruiser modules in this packet

sensor.target_height_bias_m.note: no public figure; engineering estimate consistent with the packet's other naval radar modules (horizon-geometry bias term)

sensor.environment_domain.note: surface/maritime domain selected for a shipborne air/surface search radar per authoring standard

sensor.sea_clutter_enabled.note: disabled, consistent with this packet's simplified detection model; no sourced clutter-suppression figure exists to calibrate an enabled model

sensor.enable_ducting.note: standard engine atmospheric-ducting toggle, enabled but with a lower gain/bonus than the packet's AESA modules, consistent with a shorter-range legacy radar

sensor.ducting_gain_factor.note: engineering estimate, slightly lower than the packet's AESA modules

sensor.ducting_max_bonus_m.note: engineering estimate, slightly lower than the packet's AESA modules

modeling_notes: Type 366/Mineral-ME surface-search and the Type 347G fire-control radars are not modeled as this same record; they are separate, unwritten sensor roles left as a documented gap consistent with the task's instruction to write only the listed sensor set (air-search/AESA, ESM, sonar) per hull.
